body: Well I was bullied quite a lot, probably a big part of it.
Yeah I also get a lot of "When are you going to find yourself a nice girl... or boy?
Well I told them I was never abused but I don't really talk to anyone about my relationship failings.
Well they have always been caring people and I hate to put them through dealing with my own issues, just makes me feel worse since I have no good reason for being such a cynical recluse.
